notes.title: New update 1.7.1 available
notes.content: - This update fixes a bug in which the rising pedestal in the cave level would not appear when first the green gems were placed in the eye sockets of the panther.

notes.title: New update V1.7 available
notes.content:
A new v1.7 update of The Journey Back is available. The following was changed:

- Updated UI of all menus.
- Windows, Mac and Linux are 64bit applications now.
- Compatibility added for macOS Catalina.
- Updated water visuals in outside and cave levels.
- Added small usability enhancements such as detail view for some puzzles.
- Improved quality of several visual elements and general look of the game.

notes.title: New update v1.5 available
notes.content:
- Added steam trading cards.
- Added german language.
- Added quality setting in the settings menu. Default is set to high.
- Added background mountains to outside scene.
- Added version number in main menu.
- Added little details such as grass / flowers to outside scene.
- Added water plane to both outside scene as well as caves.
- Corrected some translations.

notes.title: New update v1.4 available
notes.content:
=== Changes ===

- The graphics throughout the whole game have been updated.
- The game can now also be played in Dutch / Nederlands. Change the language in the 'Options' on the main menu.
- Structure of the main menu options changed.
- Invert Y-Axis (for looking up/down) added to the options menu.
- Added free roaming animals.
- Added dialog to show a game has been saved.
- Character model sister adjusted.
- Collision was missing for some objects.
